source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 106th ed., Permittivity (Dielectric Constant) of Liquids
citation: C. Wohlfarth. Permittivity (Dielectric Constant) of Liquids. In CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 106th ed.; CRC Press.
notes: Generated by scripts/extract_crc_solvents.py. dielectric_temperature_k is the CRC superscript temperature converted from °C to K. fit_a..fit_d are the CRC polynomial coefficients for epsilon(T) = a + bT + cT^2 + dT^3, valid for t_min_k <= T <= t_max_k.
